## Rebuilding

Normal plugin builds use the checked-in citation-engine.cjs and require no npm install. To update citation-engine.js, copy package.json and package-lock.json from this directory into a temporary directory outside iCloud, run npm ci --ignore-scripts there, then run `node scripts/build-citations.cjs /absolute/path/to/that-directory` and `python3 scripts/build-dashboard.py`. Node must also be on PATH for esbuild-wasm. Run test-citations.cjs and test-project-manager.cjs. Do not deploy node_modules or package-manager caches to the vault.
